attributes.definition: Stable reference to source media or a source-derived row, interval, region, or sample.
attributes.source_contract: analysis_id plus artifact version and row, interval, region, or sample locator
test_targets: source reference resolves after save and reopen

attributes.definition: Canonical source-clock interval or instant applicable to an evidence or analytical object.
attributes.authority_rule: analyst correction and verified anchors outrank inherited clocks
attributes.source_contract: source clock id, start, end, precision, timing status
test_targets: clock correction invalidates overlapping dependents only

attributes.definition: Versioned activity, agent, entity, input, parameter, and output lineage for a transformation.
attributes.source_contract: activity id, implementation version, inputs, parameters, outputs, actor and timestamps
test_targets: output traces to inputs and implementation version

attributes.definition: Reproducible execution of a declared statistical method over versioned governed inputs.
attributes.source_contract: method/version, population, exclusions, parameters, baselines, results, limitations and manifest
test_targets: save/reopen reproduces method population and parameters
mock result cannot become report eligible

attributes.definition: Source and observation fitness assessed independently from model confidence, maturity, and authority.
attributes.source_contract: clarity, audibility, occlusion, precision, completeness, representativeness, independence and corroboration
test_targets: low-quality evidence remains inspectable without silent promotion

attributes.definition: Source-linked empirical result emitted from a measurement run without interpretive promotion.
attributes.source_contract: measurement run, result locator, evidence refs, uncertainty, effect size, limitations and validity
test_targets: finding traces to measurement and source rows

attributes.definition: Governed speaker- or analyst-scoped claim with explicit epistemic state and evidence boundaries.
attributes.source_contract: speaker/actor, content, scope, state, support, counter-evidence, authority, maturity and validity
attributes.implementation_owner: claim extraction and canonical decision services
test_targets: asserted and denied claims coexist
speaker correction reattributes without erasing history

attributes.definition: Versioned analytical proposition derived from findings or claims and governed as a distinct object.
attributes.source_contract: subject, predicate, object/content, scope, support, counter-evidence and revision lineage
test_targets: candidate cannot write mature projection
revision preserves superseded proposition

attributes.definition: Typed support, contradiction, alternative, temporal, causal, attribution, or comparison relation between propositions.
attributes.source_contract: source and target proposition ids, relation type, scope, evidence and decision lineage
test_targets: contradiction remains visible after projection

attributes.definition: Measured or governed change of an entity, relation, situation, or proposition across canonical time.
attributes.source_contract: subject, prior state, next state, boundary, method, evidence and uncertainty
test_targets: boundary correction recomputes overlapping transition only

attributes.definition: Source-timed presence, action, speech, relation, or state event projected onto a stable Narrative Agent.
attributes.source_contract: agent, event type, source/time scope, assignment decision, evidence and validity
test_targets: agent merge/split preserves event lineage

attributes.definition: Reviewable node or edge projection sourced from governed propositions and relations.
attributes.source_contract: proposition/relation refs, source refs, projection state and stale state
test_targets: stale proposition marks dependent graph projection stale

attributes.definition: Framework-explicit, versioned interpretation with support, counter-evidence, alternatives, and commitment state.
attributes.source_contract: framework/version, interpreter, scope, propositions, support, counter-evidence, alternatives and lineage
test_targets: competing interpretations coexist
framework version change invalidates dependent output

attributes.definition: Governed Bet, Beneath, Between, Beyond, or Becoming candidate derived from an explicitly assigned, evidence-supported proposition.
attributes.source_contract: explicit 5B orientation, proposition reference, subject, scope, evidence, counter-evidence, alternatives and decision lineage
test_targets: absence alone cannot create mature Beneath event
unassigned proposition cannot enter Boje projection
projection preserves candidate authority and traceback

attributes.definition: Deterministic stakeholder-facing projection of governed findings, propositions, relations, or interpretations.
attributes.source_contract: source object ids, target feature, projection version, status and invalidation refs
test_targets: projection refreshes after source invalidation
reporting cannot mutate projection

attributes.definition: Citation-bearing report unit assembled only from eligible governed analytical objects.
attributes.source_contract: claim text, source objects, citations, status, counter-evidence, verifier result and lineage
test_targets: sentence traces to source
conflict and limitation survive rendering

attributes.definition: Reproducible assembly and export event for a governed report.
attributes.source_contract: template/version, selected claims, ordering, renderer, verifier, export artifact and process manifest
test_targets: save/reopen/export preserves claim selection and citations

coverage_summary.remaining_category_rule: Remain governed by the 47-category coverage matrix and must receive atomic contracts in the subsequent domain profile passes; they are not silently marked operational by this minimum interpretation profile.
